scale.anatomical_target: Turing pigment-stripe / ocellus wavelength realised as the most-unstable Schnakenberg mode on the day-2 planula ectoderm

evolutionary_history.what_changes_at_this_scale: No chronospecies neighbour exists, so age does not move. Relative to an organism-scale bell (~2 mm, ~231 repeats of 8.64 µm) the detail domain (reconstructed 250 µm planula, 28 repeats) is the change. Slot 0168's dimensionless template (1.63, 0.25, 9, 4, 36) is not reused.

equations.activator: du/dt = Du * laplacian(u) + gamma * (a - u + u^2 v)
equations.inhibitor: dv/dt = Dv * laplacian(v) + gamma * (b - u^2 v)

empirical_series.description: Pass-2 eigenvector probe: Jacobian growth rate versus PDE Fourier-mode growth at the same discrete wavenumber.

specimen.creator: Tsuyoshi Momose
specimen.description: DIC observation of a Clytia hemisphaerica planula two days after fertilisation.

reported_in_source: Clytia hemisphaerica is an extant hydrozoan with a planula and a medusa (Leclère et al. 2019; Momose and Houliston 2007)
A gonad opsin mediates light-induced spawning (Quiroga Artigas et al. 2018)
